name: Matchless Plastics, Inc.
old_description: At Matchless Plastics, we combine extraordinary service with the flexibility to tailor every experience to your needs.
about:
Matchless Plastics operates from Plymouth, Minnesota, where it has provided custom plastic injection molding for nearly four decades. The company began as a small operation and grew into a manufacturing partner serving customers nationwide, though the exact founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop specializes in injection molding with capabilities that include soft-touch overmolding, insert molding, custom color matching, molded internal threads, complex geometrics, and texturing. In-house CNC machining and secondary operations support tight-tolerance modifications, while assembly, pad printing, painting, and screen printing provide finished, production-ready parts. The company works with engineering-grade resins such as ABS, polycarbonate, nylon, acetal, PEEK, TPE, TPU, and glass-, carbon-, or mineral-filled materials, handling projects from prototype through large-scale production runs.

Matchless serves the heavy equipment, HVAC, consumer products, and agricultural industries. Its customer base consists of manufacturers seeking end-to-end support from design-for-manufacturability feedback through tooling, molding, and final delivery.

The company states its mission is delivering reliable, high-quality injection molding backed by exceptional service, emphasizing flexibility to accommodate last-minute changes and quick turnaround times. Core values described as grit, humbly confident, positive, and hungry guide the team's approach to problem-solving and long-term partnerships.

name: Matrix Corporation
old_description: Contract PCB Manufacturer in Wisconsin - Prototype to Production
about:
Matrix Corporation was founded in 1999 in Menomonee Falls, Wisconsin, just outside Milwaukee. The company began as a PCB design provider and has since grown into a full-service contract electronics manufacturer serving OEMs and engineering teams across the Midwest.

Today Matrix Corp builds printed circuit boards from single-unit prototypes through low-to-mid volume production, with no order minimums. Its facility handles PCB design, quick-turn and prototype fabrication, production runs scaling from hundreds to tens of thousands, turnkey assembly with surface-mount, through-hole, and mixed-technology processes, component sourcing, 3D AOI and X-ray inspection, functional testing, conformal coating and potting, and box-build integration of wiring, enclosures, and subsystems. The company reports thousands of unique assemblies produced and hundreds of active customers.

The manufacturer serves commercial electronics, consumer devices, telecommunications, healthcare and medical devices, and industrial equipment sectors, primarily in Wisconsin, Illinois, and the broader Midwest.

Matrix Corp emphasizes domestic manufacturing to avoid offshore lead-time surprises, a single-roof model that eliminates vendor handoffs, ISO 9001:2015 quality management with IPC-A-610 Class 2 workmanship and full traceability, and a commitment to on-time delivery. The firm traces its evolution to a focus on solving real-world manufacturing challenges for regulated and time-sensitive markets.

name: Maverick Power
old_description: Delivering power solutions that are as unique as your business.Our expert team ensures your systems are reliable and efficient, allowing you to achieve your goals without interruption.
about:
Maverick Power is headquartered in McKinney, Texas. The company was founded in 2020 as RMS Power by Tom Currier, Chad Dodd, John Baker, and Timmy Brent before evolving into the Maverick Power brand. The founders set out to redefine mission‑critical power solutions with a client‑first approach born from the challenges of that year.

The company designs and manufactures a range of power distribution equipment, including automatic transfer switches, medium‑voltage switchgear (1 kV to 36 kV), low‑voltage distribution systems (up to 1 kV), UL 508A‑listed industrial control panels, and uninterruptible power supply units with maintenance bypass. In addition to manufacturing, Maverick Power provides installation, maintenance and repair, consulting, field services, and full project management. Operations span multiple manufacturing facilities across North Texas and Phoenix, and the firm was ranked #16 on the 2025 Inc. 5000 list, #2 in Manufacturing and #1 in Texas.

Maverick Power serves data centers, critical‑infrastructure operators, industrial automation users, energy‑management firms, and commercial and industrial facilities that require reliable, customizable power distribution. Its solutions are built for mission‑critical environments where uptime and rapid deployment are essential.

The company states its differentiation lies in delivering customizable, efficient, and reliable power solutions that go beyond conventional systems. Its stated values — Bring Your Best, Win as a Team, Get the Job Done, and Deliver “WOW!” — reflect a culture focused on speed, quality, and exceeding customer expectations.

name: Mb Cable Company, LLC
old_description: BUNDLED CABLE FOR A DIVERSE RANGE OF APPLICATIONS IN THE ELECTRICAL INDUSTRY
about:
MB Cable Company, LLC operates from New Brunswick, New Jersey, where it assembles custom marked and bundled cable solutions for electrical contractors nationwide. The firm entered the market through a combination of organic growth and acquisition—its website notes that "One Pull is now a part of the MB Cable Family"—though a founding year and original ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company's core offering is custom bundle assemblies configured to jobsite specifications. Its product line includes straight assemblies, cross-tape assemblies, and break-out assemblies, supplemented by value-added services such as custom marking and identification, color striping, pulling grips, and sequential footage markers. Additional pre-fabricated items include whips, stripped lengths, and a solar quick-connect system. All conductors in a given bundle are sourced from a single manufacturer, a practice the company says ensures consistency from purchase through installation.

MB Cable serves the electrical construction trade, with a focus on commercial and industrial jobsites. Its solar quick-connect product and recent blog coverage of utility-scale solar economics indicate an active presence in the renewable-energy installation sector. Typical customers are electrical contractors and project managers seeking to consolidate multiple reels into a single pull, reduce scrap, and cut labor hours spent on wire identification.

The company states its mission is to increase jobsite productivity and safety while saving time and reducing cost. By eliminating the need for multiple reels and the labor associated with ringing out and marking cables, MB Cable positions its bundled solutions as a way to avoid costly scrap wire and streamline the pulling process.

name: McAllister Mills Thermal Composites
old_description: A one-source solution for thermal products and custom fabrication for a wide range of industries and applications.
about:
McAllister Mills Thermal Composites operates from Independence, Virginia. The company traces its roots to the 1980s when it was established as a technical textile manufacturer specializing in high-temperature materials.

Today it runs a vertically integrated manufacturing operation that designs and fabricates high-performance thermal insulation systems and engineered fire protection solutions. Its product range includes heat shields, removable insulation jackets, passive fire protection systems, EV battery fire safety solutions, and high-temperature gaskets. The company also maintains a global production footprint with facilities in the United States, Latvia, and Germany.

McAllister Mills serves OEMs and industrial leaders across power generation, transportation, petrochemical processing, heavy industry, gas and steam turbine manufacturing, heavy-duty engine production, electric vehicle and battery platforms, petrochemical refining, and industrial power systems. Its solutions have been applied to marine piping, off-highway equipment, rotating machinery, piping networks, emissions control systems, and thermal process equipment.

The company emphasizes engineering excellence, customer partnership, manufacturing integrity, and continuous innovation. It states that its vertically integrated model — controlling every step from material selection through final fabrication — delivers consistent quality, faster lead times, and solutions tailored to exact performance requirements.

McCann Woodworking operates from a historic carriage house in downtown Morristown, New Jersey. Founded in 2010 by Mickey McCann, the business began as a small wood shop after McCann completed training at The Krenov School in Northern California, formerly the College of the Redwoods Fine Woodworking Program. The company is organized as a limited liability company.

The shop specializes in furniture making and antique restoration, emphasizing fine hand skills and a careful eye for harmony in design. McCann works as both designer and maker, producing custom furniture pieces and restoring antique items. The operation remains a small-scale workshop without published metrics on facility size, headcount, or production volumes.

McCann Woodworking serves clients seeking custom furniture and antique restoration services. The company does not publicly list specific industry sectors or customer types beyond its core offerings in fine woodworking.

McCann’s background at The Krenov School informs the shop’s approach, focusing on hand-tool techniques and design integrity. The company highlights this training and its emphasis on craftsmanship as central to its work.

name: McLean Furniture - MFG Design Studio
old_description: Our team is available to assist with all your interior design and home furnishing needs.
about:
McLean Furniture Gallery has operated in the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area since 1984, when Tehmina Khan and her husband Imran Khan founded the business in Tysons, Virginia. Khan’s design career began five decades earlier with a haute couture line carried by Saks Fifth Avenue and other department stores before she turned her focus to interiors. The family-owned gallery now occupies a fifth-floor showroom and design studio at 8219 Leesburg Pike in Tysons Corner.

The company does not manufacture furniture; instead it represents more than 40 American furniture makers — among them heritage brands such as Harden and Henredon — and curates a selection of furniture, lighting, accessories, rugs, and custom window treatments for immediate purchase or made-to-order delivery. In addition to retail sales, the gallery provides full-service interior design, space planning, and re-upholstery work for clients looking to refresh existing pieces.

Clientele ranges from individual homeowners furnishing new residences to high-profile buyers including heads of state, corporate executives, and government officials throughout the D.C. region and beyond. The gallery’s product mix spans traditional to contemporary styles across the residential furnishing segment.

Khan’s industry recognition — including furniture designs named in her honor by Harden and Henredon and a 2021 “Best Furniture Store” award from DC Modern Luxury Magazine — underscores the gallery’s positioning as an omni-channel resource that combines product breadth with collaborative design services.

name: Meats of Montana
old_description: Call Today to order your award winning meat from Pioneer Meats
about:
Pioneer Meats operates from Big Timber, Montana, where Brian and Kary Engle established the business in 2006 on a 20-acre property. Brian’s path into meat processing began in his youth, cutting meat with his family, and later processing deer and elk for friends from a converted semi-trailer between 1993 and 1997. After earning an Animal Sciences degree from Montana State University, he and Kary restarted the venture, building a USDA-inspected facility at the current location.

The company provides custom meat processing for both domestic livestock and wild game, producing a range of cured and smoked products including snack sticks, bratwurst, bacon, sausage, hot dogs, along with proprietary sauces and spice blends. A retail store on-site sells these items directly to consumers. The facility handles cutting, grinding, curing, smoking, and packaging, though specific equipment and headcount are not disclosed.

Pioneer Meats serves individual hunters, livestock owners, and retail customers across Montana and beyond. The business is active in the meat processing industry through membership in the Montana Meat Processors Association, the North West Meat Processors Association, and the American Association of Meat Processors, with Brian Engle holding board positions in the first and third organizations.

The Engles attribute their reputation to a focus on award-winning quality; since 2005 the company has earned multiple Grand Champion titles at state and regional cured-meat shows, including Best of Show for bacon in 2009. Community involvement, from supporting local food banks to agricultural scholarships, is also cited as a core value.

name: Med Tech Solutions
old_description: Med Tech Solutions is a medical equipment sales and service provider offering a variety of equipment solutions for hospitals, clinics, veterinary offices, surgery centers and chiropractic clinics.
about:
Med Tech Solutions operates from Tulsa, Oklahoma, where it has established a central location to serve a multi-state region including Oklahoma, Texas, southern Kansas, western Missouri, and Arkansas, with national reach as well.

The company provides sales, service, and parts for medical imaging equipment. It offers new and refurbished systems including X-ray, ultrasound, C-arm, CT, bone density, portable X-ray, and computed radiography equipment. It also provides maintenance plans, certified parts, user and service manuals, and financing options.

Its customers include hospitals, clinics, veterinary offices, surgery centers, and chiropractic clinics across the region and nationally.

The company emphasizes its ISO service provider status, which allows it to design multi-vendor service contracts for radiology and biomedical equipment at reasonable prices. Its central location enables broad regional coverage and responsive support.

about:
MedEquip Depot, based in Dallas, Texas, operates as an authorized distributor of medical supplies, equipment, and furniture for healthcare facilities nationwide. The company holds SAM.gov registration (CAGE 6H2R8), a Vizient contract, and a Texas Department of Health license, positioning it for federal and institutional procurement.

The distributor consolidates products from more than 1,300 manufacturers under a single account, serving over 13,000 healthcare facilities across every clinical specialty. Its Dallas warehouse facility and direct-from-manufacturer shipping options support a catalog that spans capital equipment, clinical furniture, and daily consumables. Services include custom procedure kit assembly, real-time order tracking through a customer portal, volume pricing negotiations with manufacturers, and consolidated invoicing with Net-30 terms for qualifying institutions.

Customers range from hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers, and physician practices to dental clinics, veterinary hospitals, long-term care communities, and government agencies. The company also supports distributors, educational institutions, first responders, and commercial occupational health programs. Each sector receives dedicated quoting, order management, and account support tailored to its procurement workflows.

MedEquip Depot was founded to eliminate the administrative friction of sourcing from dozens of vendors. Its model emphasizes a dedicated account team that knows each facility’s receiving dock, manufacturer-negotiated pricing on volume orders, multiple sourcing channels for backordered items, and transparent lead-time quoting that avoids vague estimates. Custom kits are built to exact component specifications, and a returns-and-claims team handles substitutions and freight claims in writing.
